description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
# Fix dead-line retention and wrong bypasses: introduce guarded_bypass which
# only permits bypass when the chosen victim is NOT overdue (ETR >= 0). When a
# victim is already overdue (ETR < 0), bypassing is disallowed so the dead line
# is evicted and the incoming line is admitted at ETR 11, preventing thousands
# of wrong bypasses on streaming/high-RD workloads while keeping active lines safe.
name: mockingjay_guarded_t16
doc: >
  Mockingjay with guarded bypass and cold-line pollution prevention.
  Replaces unconditional capacity bypass and safe_bypass with a unified
  guarded_bypass condition. Bypass is strictly prohibited if the victim chosen
  by the search is overdue (ETR < 0), ensuring dead lines are never protected at
  the expense of incoming lines. When the victim is alive (ETR >= 0), incoming
  lines with RD > 73 or lines with RD >= 40 exceeding the victim's predicted
  remaining reuse are safely bypassed. Unknown fills receive ETR 8 to prevent
  cold-line pollution, while unknown hits receive ETR 0. Retains 16-bit sampler
  tags with 3-bit etr_clock and 7-bit set_clock within the 48 KB budget.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3
    init: 7                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps at 128, safe since max RD is 95
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - {guarded_bypass: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, field: etr, min_rd: 40}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 16
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}

- name: max_distance
  place: Extremum
  params: {clock: state}
  means: >
    Evaluates each way by computing diff = (key - clock) modulo 2^width, where width
    is the width of the key field. The clock value is truncated to this width.
    If diff >= 2^(width-1), the line is overdue, and its score is 2^width + ((clock - key) modulo 2^width).
    If diff < 2^(width-1), the line is not overdue, and its score is diff.
    The extremum is the way with the maximum score.

    adds the current value of the clock state field, and returns the result modulo 2^width

    given by the entry's signature field. In both cases, the increment is clamped
    at the table's maximum value.

    otherwise. The returned value is an unsigned integer of width 1.

description:
name: mockingjay_seesaw_v1
doc: >
  Pareto Seesaw-Damping Eviction Balancing:
  Resolves the empirical seesaw where reducing kept_dead inflated evicted_sooner.
  In Mockingjay's max_magnitude victim selection, overdue lines lingering at
  small negative ETR (-1..-3) have smaller magnitudes than active working-set
  lines with positive ETR (+4..+8), causing premature eviction of lines waiting
  for reuse. Meanwhile, lines inserted at +11 that aged downward pretended their
  reuse was approaching, displacing valid lines.
  This introduces three-zone seesaw-damped aging:
  1. Overdue purging: Lines reaching ETR <= 0 immediately become -11 (max
     magnitude, negative), ensuring immediate eviction priority over all positive lines.
  2. Retention deceleration: Active positive lines (0 < ETR < 11) age monotonically
     toward 0, increasing retention as their predicted reuse nears.
  3. Streaming isolation: Lines at +11 (INF_RD) remain at +11, remaining prime victim
     candidates without polluting the positive retention zones.
  Dynamic set dueling bypass is retained with conservative thresholds.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3
    init: 7                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps at 128
    init: ZERO
  - name: bypass_sel
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    width: 10
    init: MID

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - {duel_bypass: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, field: etr, min_rd: 40, force_rd: 74, selector: bypass_sel}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 16
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:

description:
name: mockingjay_liveness_sm_v1
doc: >
  State Machine Liveness Invariants Specification:
  Logical States:
  - STATE_DEAD (-11): Fully decayed or predicted dead (RD > 73, unknown prefetch,
    writebacks). Maximal eviction priority under max_magnitude + prefer_negative.
  - STATE_OVERDUE (-10 to -1): Passed predicted reuse window without reuse;
    monotonically aging towards STATE_DEAD.
  - STATE_IMMINENT (0): Reached predicted reuse interval; maximum retention priority
    (magnitude 0).
  - STATE_ACTIVE (+1 to +10): Line with predicted future reuse; decaying monotonically
    toward 0.
  Liveness Invariants:
  - Invariant 1 (Monotonic Decay to Dead): In the absence of hits, all active lines
    MUST monotonically transition through STATE_IMMINENT (0) to STATE_DEAD (-11)
    via clamped_dec.
  - Invariant 2 (No Inverted Protection for Dead Lines): Lines predicted to exceed
    cache capacity (RD > 73) or dead prefetches MUST enter directly in STATE_DEAD
    (-11) rather than +11, preventing artificial retention caused by decaying toward 0.
  - Invariant 3 (Hit Rejuvenation): Hits rejuvenate lines to STATE_IMMINENT (0) if
    unpredicted or to STATE_ACTIVE (+RD/8) if predicted.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3
    init: 7                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps at 128
    init: ZERO
  - name: bypass_sel
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    width: 10
    init: MID

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - {duel_bypass: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, field: etr, min_rd: 40, force_rd: 74, selector: bypass_sel}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 16
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  hit_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 7}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

  fill_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 7}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH], table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 8}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: hit_access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_not_in: [WRITE]}
    words: {update_bypass_duel: {selector: bypass_sel}}
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: fill_access

description:
name: mockingjay_ablate_ins_v1
doc: >
  Ablates the Insertion module to eliminate evicted_sooner thrashing.
  In previous designs, lines predicted dead (rdp > 73) and untrusted prefetches
  were inserted at etr = +11. Under monotonic decrement aging, their magnitude
  decreased from 11 down to 0, artificially promoting dead lines into the
  protected imminent-reuse zone for 88 set accesses and causing severe
  evicted_sooner penalties (+3135 on milc).
  By inserting dead-predicted fills and untrusted prefetches directly at etr = -11,
  they receive maximum magnitude (11) and prefer_negative priority immediately,
  ensuring they never pass through the near-reuse protection zone to displace
  active lines.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3
    init: 7                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps at 128
    init: ZERO
  - name: bypass_sel
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    width: 10
    init: MID

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - {duel_bypass: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, field: etr, min_rd: 40, force_rd: 74, selector: bypass_sel}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 16
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true

        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

  hit_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache

      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

  fill_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 7}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH], table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 8}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: -11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: hit_access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_not_in: [WRITE]}
    words: {update_bypass_duel: {selector: bypass_sel}}
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: fill_access

name: mockingjay_committee_v1
doc: >
  Micro-Architectural Persona Committee Debate & Resolution:
  - Scan-Resister: "Our highest error source is kept_dead (7,230 on milc, 2,733
    on leslie3d). In Mockingjay, lines inserted with high reuse distance (etr=11)
    never aged because the condition 'abs(etr) < 11' evaluates to false for +11!
    They remain stuck at +11 indefinitely, blocking fresh insertions."
  - Thrash-Resister: "We must prevent premature eviction of lines that will be
    reused soon. However, lines stuck at +11 also cause evicted_sooner because
    they displace lines with actual near-term reuse. Fixing aging to properly
    decrement from +11 down to -11 restores intended ETR aging order."
  - Bypass-Auditor: "Wrong_bypass remains a hazard (13k on milc). We must retain
    dynamic set dueling for bypassing with conservative thresholds (force_rd=74,
    min_rd=40), ensuring follower sets only bypass when Leader B proves fewer misses."
  - Committee Compromise: Retain set-dueled dynamic bypass arbitration while
    replacing the flawed abs-check aging with clamped_dec, enabling all lines
    from +11 down to -11 to age monotonically.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 3
    init: 7                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 7                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps at 128
    init: ZERO
  - name: bypass_sel
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    width: 10
    init: MID

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - {duel_bypass: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8, field: etr, min_rd: 40, force_rd: 74, selector: bypass_sel}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 16
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 7, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  hit_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 7}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

  fill_access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 7}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        set: {etr: {clamped_dec: {field: etr, min: -11}}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH], table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 8}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: hit_access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_not_in: [WRITE]}
    words: {update_bypass_duel: {selector: bypass_sel}}
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: fill_access
